title: Anna's Day in the Town
text:
Anna lives in a small town. She has a map of the town in her bag. The map shows the school, the park and the train station. The school is next to the park.

Anna also has a bus timetable. The bus to the city leaves at 8:15 every morning. The bus stop is near the train station. Anna looks at the timetable before she goes out.

questions.text: What does Anna have in her bag?
What time does the bus to the city leave?
Why does Anna probably look at the timetable?
options: To find out when the bus leaves

questions.text: Why might Anna walk to the park after school?
options: Because the park is close to the school
Because the park is in another country
Because the bus stop is in the park

vocabulary.definition: a drawing that shows the places in an area
a list that shows when buses or trains leave and arrive

paragraph_translations: Anna vive en un pueblo pequeño. Tiene un mapa del pueblo en su bolso. El mapa muestra la escuela, el parque y la estación de tren. La escuela está al lado del parque.
Anna también tiene un horario de autobuses. El autobús a la ciudad sale a las 8:15 cada mañana. La parada del autobús está cerca de la estación de tren. Anna mira el horario antes de salir.
